metrics.name: High-Risk Users by Device Association List
metrics.gotcha: last_login_user is a string field on DevicesDetails[]. DaysSinceLastSeen is Liongard-computed. status is a string (e.g. normal/contained).

metrics.name: Inactive Console Users Count (> 30 days)
metrics.gotcha: Users[].DaysSinceLastLogin is a Liongard-computed integer. UsersOverview.InactiveUsers provides a pre-aggregated inactive count — use for quick checks without filtering Users[].

metrics.name: Devices Without RTR Enabled Count
metrics.gotcha: rtr_state is a STRING. Compliant value is 'enabled'. Filter: rtr_state != 'enabled' catches any non-enabled value.

metrics.name: Devices in Reduced Functionality Mode Count
metrics.gotcha: reduced_functionality_mode is a STRING 'yes'/'no', not a boolean. Filter: reduced_functionality_mode == 'yes' (quoted string).

metrics.name: Stale Hosts Count (> 30 days)
metrics.gotcha: DaysSinceLastSeen is a Liongard-computed integer field on DevicesDetails[] — not the raw last_seen timestamp string.

metrics.name: Stale Hosts Count (> 7 days)
metrics.gotcha: DaysSinceLastSeen is a Liongard-computed integer field on DevicesDetails[].

metrics.name: Console Users Without MFA Count
metrics.gotcha: Users[].factors is an ARRAY of enrolled MFA factor objects — filter on empty/null factors array. UsersOverview.UsersWithMFA provides a pre-aggregated enrolled count; subtract from TotalUsers for without-MFA count.
